title: Probably the closest thing we’ll ever get to an actual Glee reunion t...
transcript: Alex Newell and Kevin McHale only overlapping for 10 days in spelling Bee is like the Glee version of when Sabrina Carpenter and Renee Rapp overlapped for three days in Mean Girls on Broadway. If you don't know, it was announced a little while ago that Alex Newell is joining Spelling Bee on August 7th. They will be playing the role of Rona Lisa Peretti, currently being played by Lilli Cooper. And then Kevin McHale just announced that he is leaving the show on August 16th, as he is now leaving to go join the Broadway cast of Rocky Horror, which leaves a 10 day, 14 performance overlap where the two Glee stars will be starring together in the show. And while Glee stars doing theatre has become very common, especially lately, this is like the only time I can think of where two of them have actually shared the stage together. I mean, we almost had Jane Lynch and Lea Michele in Funny Girl together, but then Jane left the show right before Lea started. And of course, we've had some Glee cameos in Spelling Bee, like Jonathan Groff and Darren Criss that was just as guest speller, so I don't really count that. So as a Glee fan, I feel like I have to find my way into one of these performances, because I don't know when I will get another opportunity to see a mini Glee reunion on stage.
showTitle: The 25th Annual Putnam County Spelling Bee
classificationReason: Casting news discussion: Alex Newell joining Spelling Bee and Kevin McHale leaving to join Rocky Horror. No first-hand review of any production — pure commentary on casting/scheduling overlap.
